name: Financial Instrument Reporting Equity Trading Activity Result V 03
definition: The FinancialInstrumentReportingEquityTradingActivityResult message is used by an entity or an authority to provide information on computed results data of an equity specific trading activity.

ReportHeader.name: Report Header
ReportHeader.definition: Header to provide details on when and from whom the message originates.

EquityTransparencyData.name: Equity Transparency Data
EquityTransparencyData.definition: Details the transparency data reported by a trading venue.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
